_comment: Blocklist sources. 'format' is one of: hosts | plain | adblock. Set enabled=false to drop a source without deleting it. 'weight' is informational only.
_core_capacity_comment: The bundled core tier must fit the Safari blockers: 6 parts x 40,000 rules. build.py refuses a core source union above this; the fill selection below is capped, never silently truncated.
_core_fill_comment: The core tier is no longer only the four hand-picked sources. It also takes every domain that appears in both independently curated, permissively licensed fill sources AND carries an adult-only signal: an adult TLD, a reviewed adult token, or an IDN (xn--). Consensus is the precision gate; the signal tells a real adult domain from a shared CDN or a dead parking entry. Terms that are not permissively licensed (the UT1 lists) are never used as fill sources and stay in the full Mac/DNS build only.

sources.note: Curated, conservative, very low false-positive rate.

Snapshot of the existing laptop hosts list, including ads and trackers. It stays in the full Mac/DNS list, but is no longer bundled in the core tier: those slots now go to adult domains, and a mixed ad/tracker snapshot would spend a sixth of the Safari budget on non-adult hosts.

_never_block_comment: SAFETY RAIL, applied last, after every upstream source. A poisoned or sloppy upstream list that blocks apple.com would brick the machine AND lock the user out of asking for help. Two tiers, because they are NOT the same problem.
_never_block_suffix_comment: Tier 1 — the domain and its entire subtree are protected. Only for infrastructure the OS itself depends on, where no subdomain will ever be adult content — and the exact hosts Hisn itself depends on: the update channel (raw.githubusercontent.com), the extension store and its update service, and the DoH resolvers the profile points at. One upstream list naming the update host would otherwise make every install block its own fix.
_never_block_apex_comment: Tier 2 — ONLY the apex (and www.) is protected; subdomains stay blockable. This is the tier for shared CDNs and shared hosting. Blocking all of cloudfront.net would break half the web, but d1a7uvtoy0lh7u.cloudfront.net serving a porn CDN must stay blocked. Tier 1 would silently unblock every adult site hosted on a big CDN — a large, invisible hole.
_extra_block_comment: Domains we always block regardless of upstream coverage. Add manually-reported gaps here.
_tier_comment: core = bundled: every core-tier source plus the core_fill selection. Ships in the browser extension's static ruleset, the Safari blockers and the Android seed, all of which have a hard capacity. extended = broad long-tail coverage; used by the full Mac/DNS list, where there is no rule-count ceiling. A source can be extended and still contribute a selected subset through core_fill.
